Part A: Basic Operations
A1
```{r}
v <- seq(5, 50, by = 5)

print(v)
print(length(v))
print(sum(v))
print(mean(v))
```

A2
```{r}
v <- rep(c(1, 2, 3), times = 4)
z <- rep(c(1, 2, 3), each = 4)

print(v)
print(z)
```

A3
```{r}
print(17 %% 5)
print(17 %/% 5)
print(2^10)
print(sqrt(144))
print(round(pi, 3))
```

A4
```{r}
a <- c(2, 4, 6, 8)
b <- c(1, 3, 5, 7)

print(a + b)
print(a * b)
print(a > b)
print(sum(a * b))
```

A5
```{r}
students<- paste("Student-", 1:3, sep = "")

print(students)

print(typeof(42))
print(typeof(42L))
print(typeof("42"))
print(typeof(41i))
print(typeof(TRUE))
```

Part B: Data Frames and Conditional Statements
B1
```{r}
students <- data.frame(
  id = 1:8,
  name = c("Alice", "Bruno", "Chen", "Dana", "Eli", "Farid", "Grace", "Hiro"),
  sex = c("F", "M", "F", "F", "M", "M", "F", "M"),
  Section = c("A", "B", "A", "C", "B", "C", "A", "B"),
  midterm = c(78, 85, 92, 67, 74, 88, 95, 59),
  final = c(82, 79, 96, 71, 80, 91, 93, 65),
  attendance = c(95, 88, 100, 72, 90, 85, 98, 60),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

print(students)
```

B2
```{r}
str(students)
dim(students)
names(students)
summary(students)
```
B3
```{r}
students$average <- round(rowMeans(students[, c("midterm", "final")]), 1
)
print(students)
```

B4
```{r}
students$passed <- students$average >= 70 & students$attendance >= 75

print(students)
```

B5
```{r}
students$standing <- ifelse(
  students$average >= 90,
  "Honors",
  ifelse(students$average >= 75, "Good", "Need Support")
)
print(students)
```

B6
```{r}
classify <-function(score) {
  if (score>= 85) {
    return("Distinction")
  } else if (score >= 70) {
    return("Merit")
  } else if (score >= 50) {
    return("Pass")
  } else {
    return("Return")
  }
}
result <- sapply(c(90, 73, 55, 40), classify)
print(result)
```

Part C: rbind() and cbind()
C1
```{r}
new_students <- data.frame(
  id = c(9, 10),
  name = c("Ines", "Jamal"),
  sex = c("F", "M"),
  Section = c("C", "A"),
  midterm = c(81, 70),
  final = c(84, 68),
  attendance = c(92, 80)
)

new_students$average <- round(
  rowMeans(new_students[, c("midterm", "final")]), 1
)
new_students$passed <- new_students$average >= 70 &
  new_students$attendance >= 75
new_students$standing <- ifelse(
  new_students$average >= 90, "Honors",
  ifelse(new_students$average >= 75, "Good", "Need Support")
)
students <- rbind(students, new_students)

print(students)
```

C2
```{r}
quiz <- c(8, 7, 10, 6, 7, 9, 10, 5, 8, 6)

students$quiz <- quiz

print(students)
class(students)
```
C3
```{r}
m <- cbind(
  midterm = students$midterm,
  final = students$final
)

m <- rbind(m, mean = colMeans(m))

m
```

C4
```{r}
bad <- data.frame(
  student_id = c(11, 12),
  student_name = c("Ana", "Ben")
)

tryCatch(
  rbind(students, bad),
  error = function(e) {
    message("rbind failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
    NULL
  }
)
```

PartD:Subsetting
D1
```{r}
print(students_all$name)
print(students_all[["name"]])
print(students_all[, "name"])
```

D2
```{r}
print(students_all[2:5, c("name", "midterm", "final")])
```

D3
```{r}
result <- students_all[students_all$attendance > 90, ]

print(result)
```
D4
```{r}
result <- subset(
  students_all,
  sex == "F" & Section %in% c("A", "C") & final >= 75,
  select = c(name, Section, final)
)

print(result)
```

D5
```{r}
highest <- which.max(students_all$average)

print(students_all$name[highest])

lowest <- which.min(students_all$average)

print(students_all$name[lowest])
```

D6
```{r}
sorted_students <- students_all[
  order(students_all$average, decreasing = TRUE),
]

print(head(sorted_students, 3))
```

Part E: BasicFactor
E1
```{r}
students_all$Section <- factor(students_all$Section)
students_all$sex <- factor(students_all$sex)

print(levels(students_all$Section))
print(levels(students_all$sex))
```

E2
```{r}
print(table(students_all$sex))

print(table(students_all$Section))

print(table(students_all$sex, students_all$Section))
```

E3
```{r}
print(as.integer(students_all$sex))
```

E4
```{r}

students_all$sex_label <- factor(
  students_all$sex,
  levels = c("F", "M"),
  labels = c("Female", "Male")
)
print(levels(students_all$sex_label))
```

E5
```{r}
print(summary(students_all$sex_label))

female_mean <- mean(
  students_all$average[students_all$sex_label == "Female"],
  na.rm = TRUE
)

print(female_mean)

male_mean <- mean(
  students_all$average[students_all$sex_label == "Male"],
  na.rm = TRUE
)

print(male_mean)
```
